sections.title: What does it mean?
sections.content: The subject is the person or thing that a sentence is about or that performs the action. Hungarian has personal pronouns such as *én*, *te* and *ő*.

sections.title: How does it work?
sections.content: The basic singular personal pronouns are *én* (I), *te* (you) and *ő* (he/she). Hungarian uses *ő* for both he and she.

sections.title: Why does it look like this?
sections.content: English uses he and she as separate pronouns. Hungarian uses one third-person singular pronoun, *ő*. Later, the verb will often give you even more information about the subject.
Do not look for a separate Hungarian word meaning “he” and another meaning “she”. Both are *ő*.
